## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For runtime changes, name the platform,
Chrome version, Phase Pal build, native host identity, and checks still needed.
Keep local tests separate from live browser and packaged-player evidence.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Checks cover the changed behavior, where needed.
- [ ] No audio recordings, credentials, private browser data, or local settings are included.
- [ ] Permissions, data use, and license notices remain accurate.
- [ ] Repository visibility and publication settings were not changed.
